remarks: Charming Single Family Rental Home in Stamford, CT  Welcome to your new haven of comfort and convenience! This delightful single-family rental home in Stamford, CT, perfectly blends charm and character with modern amenities. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a bright and airy interior adorned with beautiful oak floors that exude warmth and sophistication. The inviting fireplace serves as a focal point, creating a cozy ambiance for those chilly evenings-"they don't make 'em like they used to!"  The home features a convenient in-home office, ideal for remote work or study, allowing you to maintain productivity without sacrificing comfort. Step outside to the expansive rear deck, perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying quiet moments in your own oasis. The full basement offers ample storage space or the potential for additional living area, while the detached garage provides extra convenience for your storage or hobby projects.  Enjoy the benefits of economical gas heating, city water, and sewer services, ensuring a hassle-free living experience. The comfortable backyard invites you to relax and unwind, making it an excellent space for outdoor gatherings, gardening, or simply soaking up the sun.  Don't miss your chance to make this lovely home your own-come and have a look today!
